BiblicalUsage: lôaʻ means the gullet — rare in the text, and exact where it appears. In Proverbs 23:2, "And put a knife to thy throat".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the knife at the throat is wisdom's picture of appetite — if I am given to it, I had better fear it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
